d: Spiky, short ice-blue hair sweeps upward, paired with sharp, narrow ice-blue eyes and a stern expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is lean and muscular, dressed in a dark navy open-chested outfit featuring a cropped top, matching trousers, and a long navy coat lined with thick, fluffy white fur at the collar, cuffs, and hem. A large, fluffy white fur scarf wraps around the neck, while the left arm is encased in jagged, translucent ice crystals.
